title: Hurricane Harvey Search and Rescue Mission (546955)
description: BEAUMONT, Texas (Aug. 30, 2017) Sailors assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 7 conduct a Search and Rescue (SAR) mission at a residence in Beaumont, Texas in support of Hurricane Harvey relief efforts. HSC-7 sent personnel and aircraft to the area to bolster Northern Command's support of FEMA's disaster response efforts. (U.S. Navy video)
